key_insight: AtomSteer adds structural constraint control to pretrained atomistic generative models at inference time, without retraining or architectural changes.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps generate crystals, molecular conformers, and protein–ligand structures that better satisfy symmetry and stereochemical requirements while limiting structural disruption.
method: Correct intermediate predictions during sampling using bounded local projections.
Apply graph-rigid stereochemical transformations and periodic-symmetry projections.
Accept updates that improve constraint satisfaction while limiting changes elsewhere in the structure.
evidence_signal: Across FlowMM, ET-Flow, and Boltz-2, the abstract reports improved crystal space-group coverage and recovery, molecular validity and E/Z accuracy, and fewer ligand E/Z errors with competitive docking success and PoseBusters validity.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify inference overhead or improvement magnitudes, leaving deployment cost and practical gains to be assessed.
paper_title: AtomSteer: Test-Time Constraint Steering for Atomistic Generative Models
